steps.description: This is the empty-input case in `tokenize`, another common blind spot. The page calls it the EOF / empty-input case in the lexer.
`tokenize` takes the source string and checks whether it is empty after stripping whitespace. The comment marks the check as easy to miss.
When the source has no non-whitespace characters, it returns a single `EOF` token. The trailing `...` marks the rest of the lexer, which handles non-empty input.
